end.summary:
Arjun showed understanding of converting distances to the same unit before comparing, including converting kilometres to metres.
They practised ordering three or more mixed-unit distances by changing all values to metres; the order was not steady yet.
They compared 2 km 90 m as 2,090 m and identified the increasing order in one set.
The mix-up of comparing the numbers before matching units was not corrected after it appeared; this needs checking next time.
end.parentNote: Asha practised changing each distance into metres before comparing or ordering them. Arjun showed this method in several examples, including 1 km 50 m = 1,050 m and 2 km 90 m = 2,090 m. They still mixed up the comparison when the units were left different, and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Arjun to convert three mixed-unit distances to metres first, then arrange them from shortest to longest.
